subject: Math
text_verbatim: Chapter 1 Numberland Adventures: Up to 999 Discovery Playground Guess the number! Work with your partner to draw OR make each number using coloured paper. The first one has been done for you. 246 300 + 10 + 2 209 7 hundreds + 1 ten + 3 ones 470 7

exercises.label: Guess the number! - Row 1 (worked example)
exercises.instruction_verbatim: The first one has been done for you.
exercises.answer_key: 246 = 2 hundreds + 4 tens + 6 ones (shown as the worked example: 2 hundred-flats, 4 ten-rods, 6 unit-cubes).

exercises.label: Guess the number! - Row 2
exercises.instruction_verbatim: Work with your partner to draw OR make each number using coloured paper.

exercises.label: Guess the number! - Row 3
exercises.instruction_verbatim: Work with your partner to draw OR make each number using coloured paper.
exercises.answer_key: 209 = 2 hundreds + 0 tens + 9 ones -> draw 2 hundred-flats + 0 ten-rods + 9 unit-cubes.

exercises.label: Guess the number! - Row 4
exercises.instruction_verbatim: Work with your partner to draw OR make each number using coloured paper.
exercises.answer_key: 7 hundreds + 1 ten + 3 ones = 713 -> draw 7 hundred-flats + 1 ten-rod + 3 unit-cubes.

exercises.label: Guess the number! - Row 5
exercises.instruction_verbatim: Work with your partner to draw OR make each number using coloured paper.
exercises.answer_key: 470 = 4 hundreds + 7 tens + 0 ones -> draw 4 hundred-flats + 7 ten-rods + 0 unit-cubes.
